description: Replace the whole set of profiles enabled on a workspace. The list is not merged: any profile absent from it is dropped, so send the complete set you want. Enabling audit-scitt/1.0 on a workspace that already has entries starts the chain from that point and leaves the earlier entries permanently outside it, which chap.audit.verify_chain then reports as not_evaluated. Prefer setting profiles at chap.workspace.create, where no entries exist yet to strand.

profiles.description: The complete profile set to enable, replacing the current one. Adding audit-scitt/1.0 to a workspace that already has entries leaves those entries unchained and outside chain verification.

name: chap.workspace.set_profiles
title: Replace workspace profiles
